content.title: Michigan vs UConn picks, predictions for national championship game
content.text: April 4, 2026Updated April 6, 2026, 10:21 a.m. MTNo. 1 seed Michigan and No. 2 seed UConn play on Monday, April 6, in the March Madness NCAA Tournament national championship game at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, Indiana.The national title game is scheduled for 5:50 p.m. MST (8:50 p.m. ET) and can be seen on TBS, TNT and truTV (stream with Sling TV).Who will win the national championship basketball game?Check out these national championship game picks and national championship game predictions for the men's college basketball national title game matchup.Michigan is a 6.5-point favorite over UConn in the game in national championship game odds provided by BetMGM Sportsbook. The Wolverines are -300 on the moneyline. The Huskies are +240. The over/under for the game is set at 144.5 points.National championship game picks: UConn vs Michigan | The Republic's score prediction | Win probabilities | Title projectionWatch UConn vs Michigan on Sling TVThe Arizona Republic: Michigan 88, UConn 80Jeremy Cluff writes: "Michigan star Yaxel Lendeborg's status looms large in this game, but the Wolverines showed their depth in their impressive win over Arizona and are a big favorite for a reason. UConn is going for its third title in four seasons, but Michigan's defense will prove to be too much for the Huskies." It will lock it in on Monday night."National championship game odds: UConn vs Michigan | Title odds | Betting oddsSporting News: Michigan 81, UConn 72Bill Bender writes: "UConn is 5-1 S/U against Big Ten schools in the tournament under Hurley with five straight victories. The Huskies can frustrate an offense, but this is not an ordinary offense. Michigan is 4-2 S/U when limited to 72 points or less, and that would be the Huskies' best hope to score one more upset. Michigan simply is playing at a championship level, and that will show through Monday."Asbury Park Press: Michigan 72, UConn 64Bob Jordan writes: "Michigan beat UConn 59-0 the last time they met - in football. Thankfully for Huskies' fans, UConn has a 2-1 edge in men's basketball. The last hoops meeting was a 74-60 Huskies' victory on November 25, 2015. This is the first time the programs will meet in the NCAA Tournament. The pick here is Michigan because No. 1 seeds are due — the No. 1s have failed to win the tournament the last three years (a long drought, considering No. 1s have won 65% of the tournaments since 1985)."How to watch national championship game: UConn vs Michigan | Schedule | TV channels | Time | Streaming | AnnouncersBookies.com: Bet UConn with the points vs MichiganBill Speros writes: "Michigan (-1.5) demolished Arizona Saturday in a battle of top seeds, showing the same mettle it's carried all season. The Wolverines have beaten their five March Madness opponents by an average of 21.4 points, averaging 94.4 points. They bring balance, versatility, and physical ferocity. Yaxel Lendeborg may not be 100% Monday, but he'll play. The line moved from 6.5 to 7.5 points following Michigan's all-around dominance. All signs point to Michigan's first national title since 1989. But UConn has been in this spot before. The Huskies are 6-0 straight up and ATS in their previous six national title appearances. UConn - given its balance and tenacity - merits better than this number. Take the points, as UConn covers.
